name: On-Screen Takeoff
summary: ConstructConnect's AI-assisted desktop measurement tool with auto-naming and auto-counting.
differentiator: ConstructConnect sells it alongside PlanSwift, so the same company offers two overlapping desktop takeoff products. The choice comes down to workflow, because On-Screen Takeoff leans on AI-assisted measuring and PlanSwift on building items by drag and drop. Reported pricing is around $1,044 per user per year, with training packages of $500 to $5,000 extra.
pricing: Not published. Third-party trackers report from $87 per user per month (about $1,044 per year), up to roughly $1,850 per year depending on bundling, with training extra.
entryPrice: Reported about $87 per user per month
bestFor: Estimators who want AI-assisted counting on large plan sets.
skipIf: You want a published price before a sales call.
